changes: Improved local review assurance diagnostics: autopilot_review_status now exposes allRuns/latestRuns alongside the default-run view; review_escalation_status shows voluntaryLocalRounds even when required=false; stale-material review assurance failures now render an explicit recovery runbook; related docs and smoke coverage were updated.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/cli.js autopilot_review_status {"storyId":"B-xxxx"} to inspect all local run ids/latest runs; run node packages/main/dist/cli.js review_escalation_status {"storyId":"B-xxxx"} to inspect required/ok plus voluntaryLocalRounds; stale DONE blocks now print Stale material recovery commands.
expectedOutcome: User sees runs: default-run, round-1, round-2, round-3; user sees voluntaryLocalRounds: 3/3 while required: false and ok: true; stale DONE output shows Stale material recovery with validate, verification_evidence_refresh_stale, and autopilot_review_submit commands.
actualTranscript: Validated transcript in .lattice/story/actives/B-7adb/evidence/transcript-diff.md: autopilot_review_status showed runCount: 4 and runs: default-run, round-1, round-2, round-3; review_escalation_status showed required: false, ok: true, voluntaryLocalRounds: 3/3 rounds x 2 hosts; stale formatter output showed Stale material recovery and Do not bypass stale material checks.
outcomeDiff: No user-value gap found; actual output matches expected diagnostic UX. Environment note: worktree global lattice binary used old global dist, so transcript used node packages/main/dist/cli.js after build; after merge to main, main must be built for the global entrypoint.

pitfalls: INIT scope anti-expansion blocked exact future-scope phrases in negative-scope text; reviewer passes require fully qualified reviewRunId; worktree global lattice can point at an older global build, so use local dist for pre-merge transcript and build main after merge.
